newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian twins in suicide puzzle.
newsitem.headline: Croatian twins in suicide puzzle.

text.p: A 57-year-old Croatian man and his twin brother committed suicide in different locations within hours of each other, apparently by chance, local media said on Monday.

The newspaper Vecernji List said the suicides were unusual in that Branko and Ivan Uhiltil, of Lipovljani 80 km (50 miles) east of Zagreb, appeared to have killed themselves over the weekend without the other knowing.
Branko Uhitil hanged himself at his house and two hours later Ivan shot himself in his flat. Both lived with their respective families. What drove them to suicide remained unknown.
